verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.composio.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured Composio documentation index. Docs pages are also served as agent-friendly .md variants (e.g. sessions-via-mcp.md, agent-setup.md), and an Agent Skill is offered so coding agents can follow the current integration path. A machine-readable openapi.json is also available. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents actually consume these agent-oriented docs effectively.
